Lean.PrettyPrinter.Parenthesizer.description: A type representing a component of the pretty printer that handles the placement of parentheses.

Lean.PrettyPrinter.Parenthesizer.node.pa.fullDefinition: def node.parenthesizer (k : SyntaxNodeKind) (p : Parenthesizer) : Parenthesizer := do   checkKind k   visitArgs p
Lean.PrettyPrinter.Parenthesizer.node.pa.description: A function that retrieves a parenthesizer associated with a specific kind of syntax node.

Lean.PrettyPrinter.Formatter.description: A type representing a component of the pretty printer responsible for formatting.

Lean.PrettyPrinter.Formatter.node.format.fullDefinition: def node.formatter (k : SyntaxNodeKind) (p : Formatter) : Formatter := do   checkKind k;   visitArgs p
Lean.PrettyPrinter.Formatter.node.format.description: A function that generates a formatter based on a given syntax node kind and an existing formatter.

Lean.PrettyPrinter.Formatter.State.stack.description: A function that retrieves the format stack from the state of the formatter.

Lean.PrettyPrinter.Delaborator.Delab.description: A type representing a component responsible for the delaboration process in the pretty printer.

Lean.PrettyPrinter.Delaborator.whenPPOpt.fullDefinition: def whenPPOption (opt : Options → Bool) (d : Delab) : Delab := do   let b ← getPPOption opt   if b then d else failure
Lean.PrettyPrinter.Delaborator.whenPPOpt.description: A function that modifies delaboration behavior based on a given option from the Lean configuration settings.

Lean.PrettyPrinter.Delaborator.delabFora.fullDefinition: def delabForall : Delab := do   delabForallBinders fun curNames dependent stxBody => do     let e ← getExpr     let prop ← try isProp e catch _ => pure false     let stxT ← withBindingDomain delab     let group ← match e.binderInfo with     | BinderInfo.implicit       => `(bracketedBinderF|{$curNames* : $stxT})     | BinderInfo.strictImplicit => `(bracketedBinderF|⦃$curNames* : $stxT⦄)     -- here `curNames.size == 1`     | BinderInfo.instImplicit   => `(bracketedBinderF|[$curNames.back : $stxT])     | _                         =>       -- NOTE: non-dependent arrows are available only for the default binder info       if dependent then         if prop && !(← getPPOption getPPPiBinderTypes) then           return ← `(∀ $curNames:ident*, $stxBody)         else           `(bracketedBinderF|($curNames* : $stxT))       else         return ← curNames.foldrM (fun _ stxBody => `($stxT → $stxBody)) stxBody     if prop then       match stxBody with       | `(∀ $groups*, $stxBody) => `(∀ $group $groups*, $stxBody)       | _                       => `(∀ $group, $stxBody)     else       `($group:bracketedBinder → $stxBody)
Lean.PrettyPrinter.Delaborator.delabFora.description: A tool that converts a universal quantification expression into a more detailed or expanded representation in the context of the Lean pretty printer.
